about: The statement M13 owes for every Series fetched from BLS, Treasury Fiscal Data and the Federal Reserve Board: how far its values may be from v1's over the Periods both hold, and why. scripts/v1-overlap.mjs compares a release built from a capture store with a release of v1's values (atlas legacy-release) against it. abs is in v1's unit: half a unit of the last decimal v1 kept (two for a figure in percent, three otherwise) unless why says more. factor brings the Origin's unit to v1's. exceptions are Periods further off than abs, each with what was found; they are counted, never hidden. different marks a Series that is another quantity than v1's by a recorded decision. v1: null says v1 had no such Series. A Period the engine marks partial (the month in progress) is not compared. The comparison is of figures fetched within days of each other: an Origin's later revision is a difference this file does not allow for. Nothing here is data.

v1 held the quarter-end total in millions of dollars from FRED's GFDEBTN; here the last business day of the quarter from Debt to the Penny, in dollars, is divided by a million. FRED's figures are whole millions and come from another Treasury publication. 93 of the 106 quarters agree to within $1 million and five more to within $3.6 million; $5 million (under a millionth of the total) is allowed, and the seven quarters beyond it are explained one by one.

exceptions.2020-Q1: v1's figure is the total of 31 January 2020 (to $0.12 million), not of 31 March: about $463 billion less than the quarter's end.
exceptions.2013-Q4: v1's figure is the total of 31 October 2013 (to $1.9 million), not of 31 December: about $196 billion less than the quarter's end.
exceptions.2012-Q1: v1's figure is $24.4 billion (0.16 percent) above Debt to the Penny for 30 March 2012 and matches no day near it. Not traced further.
exceptions.2010-Q2: v1's figure is $1.7 billion (0.013 percent) below Debt to the Penny for 30 June 2010. Not traced further.
exceptions.2012-Q2: v1's figure is $1.3 billion (0.008 percent) below Debt to the Penny for 29 June 2012. Not traced further.
exceptions.2003-Q3: v1's figure is $89 million above Debt to the Penny for 30 September 2003. Not traced further.
exceptions.2005-Q4: v1's figure is $11.5 million below Debt to the Penny for 30 December 2005. Not traced further.

v1 kept three decimals of the mean of the Wednesday levels dated in the month. A weekly Observation here is the ISO week of its Wednesday, and the engine files a week under the month its last day (a Sunday) falls in; for this comparison the weeks are filed by their Wednesday, as v1 filed them. The engine's own monthly mean differs from v1's in a month whose last Wednesday's week ends in the next month: a difference of representation, stated in docs/v2/v1-overlap.md.
